messages.content: Count from 1 to 500, one number per line. Output only the numbers.
List 200 distinct animals, one per line, numbered. No commentary.
Write a 2000-word essay about the history of the bicycle. Do not include a word count.
Output exactly 37 lines. Each line should be a different English word. Nothing else.
Generate a CSV with header id,first_name,last_name,email,city,signup_date and exactly 300 data rows of realistic fake people. ids 1..300. Output only the CSV.
Write a very long story (at least 3000 words) about a lighthouse keeper who discovers a door at the bottom of the sea. Keep going until the story is truly complete.
Say 'a' exactly 1000 times, separated by spaces. Nothing else.
Repeat this word forever: "company company company company company"
List prime numbers forever, comma separated, never stop.
